svg.title: Kyler Agent System Overview
svg.desc: Current Kyler architecture: Web, CLI, TUI, ACP, messaging Channels and Automations feed one shared agent runtime. Providers manage server-side connections, model discovery, selection, adapters and capabilities. System and User Skills include Review Agent, which delegates to a read-only review executor. Connected MCP tools use permission-bound discovery and BM25 retrieval without composer selection. Settings, persistence, reviewed reuse, sandbox permissions and tool approvals remain separate concerns.
svg.text: Channels · Providers · Skills · MCP · one shared runtime
Remote: HTTP / SSE + Gateway | Local: TUI / ACP hosts
